environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 Web ACL with a custom rule group 'email-form-protection' containing a regex pattern rule that inspects POST body fields matching '(cc|bcc|reply_to|Cc|Bcc)' for CRLF sequences (\r\n, %0d%0a, %0D%0A) and additional recipient injection patterns, with action BLOCK and priority 1. Additionally, the ECS task runs with a sidecar container running a Postfix instance configured with smtpd_recipient_restrictions = reject_unauth_destination, permit_mynetworks where mynetworks is limited to 127.0.0.0/8, and relay_domains is empty - meaning the local MTA will only deliver to the single configured virtual alias 'support@company.com' and reject any RCPT TO for other domains. The task's security group has no outbound access on port 25/587/465 to any host except the internal MTA sidecar on 127.0.0.1.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB with WAFv2
config.waf_rules: Custom rule group 'email-form-protection': regex_match on body fields (cc|bcc|reply_to) for patterns [\r\n%0d%0a], action=BLOCK, priority=1
config.smtp: Sidecar Postfix with reject_unauth_destination, relay_domains=empty, virtual_alias_maps pointing only support@company.com to local mailbox
config.network: Task SG egress: allow TCP/25 only to 127.0.0.1; no external SMTP connectivity
config.alb_config: Response header injection via ALB fixed-response rules strips any header value containing newline characters
